subject: East glazed gable and short north return above the corner. Lengths in assembly coordinates before the common scale.

east_2020_original_pixels.occlusion: The trunk covers the centre and right side of the gable. The exposed left section confirms the slender dark bars, main horizontal transom and pale sill. No extra row inferred from reflections.

north_2015_original_pixels.obscuration: Near corner and much of the second window lie behind branches.

north_opposite_native_pixels.limits: First window shows a multilight sash. The second frame is narrower and darker. Few individual bars can be traced there.

geometry.prow_reading: Dark vertical joints in the triangular panel. Two pale soffit and dark outer rake lines; some roof-course relief is illustrative. Rear intersection with the house is a cut.

height_sensitivity.street_unconstrained_intersection: First high north sill/head at 7.81/8.96 street metres, used with the provisional garden datum and scale.
height_sensitivity.fixed_plane_photo_ratio: When each photo is independently read on the north facade, 0.91 and 0.99 of the lower window height separates its head from the upper sill; adopted lower head 4.24 makes this 5.30–5.40 on the provisional scale. A rectification of the east glazed band calibrated only from the lower pair yielded 5.1–5.3. Separate image registrations explain the variation.
height_sensitivity.component_interface: base_z parameter controls the complete upper part, including every window, the ridge and eaves. Frame material and solar reflections can change between 2015 and 2020.

adopted.aligned_section_range: East gable, eaves, ridge and second north window translated together .55 below the exploratory base. Only the north eastern window was centred horizontally and shortened using held-out observations in the three street views.
